MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, using the supplied regime; breadth is 7/11 sectors positive, with Communication and Consumer Discretionary leading while Technology and Energy are negative. Leadership is mixed (Top 5 span 3 sectors); risk and cycle signals are N/A, so there is no clear Growth or Value style confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads (+5.62% 1W): CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary is next (+3.40%), with LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare gained 1.88%, with LLY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +21.11%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest (-6.52% 1W): XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%) BELOW TREND and PSX (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -10.93%) BELOW TREND. Technology fell 1.94%, with NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND; Utilities declined 0.51%, with SRE (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -4.27%) BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) ABOVE TREND; TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND; TMUS (1W: +9.50% | 1M: +11.33%) ABOVE TREND; LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: mixed (3 sectors in Top 5), short of the broad-leadership threshold.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DOW (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +11.95%) CORRECTION; WMB (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -9.05%) BELOW TREND; XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%) BELOW TREND; PSX (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -10.93%) BELOW TREND; SRE (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -4.27%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Energy, with DOW showing a short-term pullback against its positive monthly return.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, and NEM (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: MSFT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -18.52%) RECOVERY, and META (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -13.67%) RECOVERY; watch for trend breaks.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak sector aggregate: Technology fell 1.94% over 1W and 10.94% over 1M across 24 constituents; individual positive-stock breadth was not supplied. NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) is BELOW TREND, while AAPL (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +2.21%) is ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -1.48%) is in RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained 1.10% over 1W and 3.33% over 1M, though individual-stock breadth was not supplied. JPM (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +2.32%), V (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +8.87%), and MA (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +10.71%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare gained 1.88% over 1W and 8.88% over 1M; individual-stock breadth was not supplied. JNJ (1W: +5.49% | 1M: +6.46%) and LLY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +21.11%) are ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%) is also ABOVE TREND, despite negative news sentiment.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio stance?
Favor selective exposure to areas showing positive sector returns, including Communication and Consumer Discretionary; reduce exposure to persistent weakness in Energy and Technology, particularly NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND. Style is mixed, not a confirmed Growth-versus-Value rotation; major single-stock divergences argue for tactical positioning rather than a strong regime bet.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, if gains hold; LLY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +21.11%) ABOVE TREND, if healthcare strength persists. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND and XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%) BELOW TREND, unless selling pressure eases.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+5.62% 1W) and Consumer Discretionary (+3.40% 1W), with breadth supported by positive sector returns. BEARISH: Energy (-6.52% 1W) and Technology (-1.94% 1W); monitor whether weakness broadens beyond the current sector-level declines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not provided, so monitor trend and return triggers instead: NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND for stabilization; AAPL (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +2.21%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through; JPM (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +2.32%) ABOVE TREND for continuation. A sustained reversal in Energy would also require improvement from XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%) BELOW TREND.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TTWO (+65): GTA VI pre-orders reportedly tracking far above plan; TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price strength. EL (+45): price-target increase; EL (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +13.38%) ABOVE TREND, also confirming the positive tone.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-45): Medicare plan exits across 140 counties; UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%) ABOVE TREND, a price-sentiment divergence to monitor. NVDA (-35): news cites scrutiny of the AI boom; NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness; BA (-35): October deliveries declined, while BA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -8.51%) is in RECOVERY, an early divergence that needs follow-through.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with 7/11 sectors positive and leadership mixed; style is mixed with no clear Growth-versus-Value lead. CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Major divergence in large-cap Technology and negative NVDA sentiment warrant monitoring for a trend break.
